ns2:course.label: Ibsen in Translation
ns2:course.description: Ibsen's major plays: Brand, Peer Gynt, and the entire prose cycle from Pillars of Society to When We Dead Awaken. Same as CWL 463 and THEA 483. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One college-level literature or theatre course, or consent of instructor.
